bridge.title: Tally bridge checklist
bridge.s1: Owner picks the import computer: an office PC or a Windows machine in India with a TallyPrime licence.
bridge.s2: Admin deploys the tally-bridge Edge Function (Mumbai) and gives the bridge its own device key — never the Supabase secret key.
bridge.s3: The bridge downloads the stored backup and restores it in TallyPrime into its own data folder, never over the live Tally.
bridge.s4: In TallyPrime, switch on the XML/HTTP server on port 9000 (F1 → Settings → Advanced Configuration) and open the restored company.
bridge.s5: The bridge reads masters and vouchers through port 9000 and sends the rows to this batch.
bridge.s6: The batch shows “Read”. Press “Check and load” in the history below; differences go to the Bug fixer.
bridge.owner: Open question for the owner: which computer is the import computer.

template.title: Template columns
template.products: Products: name (required), item code, group, unit, HSN, MRP.
template.parties: Parties: name (required), GSTIN, PAN, phone or WhatsApp, address, group, opening balance.
template.employees: Employees: name (required), employee code, PAN, mobile, date of birth, Aadhaar (only the last 4 digits are kept).
template.synonyms: Common names are understood, e.g. “Party name”, “GST No”, “Mobile”, “HSN/SAC”, “UOM”. Unknown columns are ignored.
template.tally: From Tally: in TallyPrime export masters (groups, ledgers, stock items, units, godowns) and the day book as XML, then upload each file here.

history.title: Import history
history.caption: Import batches
history.empty: No imports yet. Each batch will appear here with its rows, user and time, and can be undone until it is approved.
history.approveEffect: Approving locks batch {{code}}: it can no longer be undone. Records it created stay “to review” until checked.
history.undoDescription: Removes the records this batch created that are still “to review” and closes its open Bug fixer items. Linked records are kept. This is logged.
history.errReason: Say why, in at least 5 characters.

what.daybook: Keeps every voucher line as reference history. A Day Book has one line per voucher (no counter-legs), so nothing is posted to the books.
what.trial_balance: Reads each ledger’s closing balance. After the CA has checked the numbers, Admin can set them as opening balances (nothing is posted).
what.stock_summary: Reads each item’s closing quantity, rate and value. Admin or the stores approver can post them as opening stock, once.
what.balance_sheet: Reads the group totals of both sides. Kept to compare with the ERP; a Balance Sheet never posts anything.

how.daybook: Display More Reports → Day Book. Set the period (the whole history is fine). Press Alt+E (Export), choose Excel (Spreadsheet), then Export. Upload the .xlsx file here.
how.trial_balance: Display More Reports → Trial Balance. Set the period to the date you want as opening. Press Alt+F5 (Expanded) so every ledger shows, then Alt+E (Export) → Excel (Spreadsheet). A sheet with groups only cannot be used.
how.stock_summary: Display More Reports → Stock Summary. Set the date. Press Alt+E (Export) → Excel (Spreadsheet). Closing quantity, rate and value are read.
how.balance_sheet: Display More Reports → Balance Sheet. Set the date. Press Alt+E (Export) → Excel (Spreadsheet). Both the side-by-side and the vertical layout are read.

reports.xmlToo: XML exports of these reports are also read, but they have not been tried against a real TallyPrime file yet; check the totals shown before loading.
reports.order: 1 Masters (From Tally) · 2 Trial Balance (CA checks, Admin applies) · 3 Stock Summary (apply) · 4 Day Book (history) · 5 Balance Sheet (compare).
reports.fileHelpDayBook: .xlsx (or a Tally XML day book). About 45,000 lines are fine.
reports.asOfHelp: The date the report shows. Read from the file when it says so; correct it here if needed.
reports.errDayBookHeader: This is not a Day Book sheet: the header row needs Date, Particulars, Vch Type and a Debit or Credit column.
reports.errTbHeader: No “Particulars” column was found. Export the Trial Balance from TallyPrime as Excel.
reports.errTbColumns: No Debit / Credit (or Closing Balance) columns were found in this Trial Balance.
reports.errStockHeader: No “Particulars” column was found. Export the Stock Summary from TallyPrime as Excel.
reports.errStockColumns: The Quantity and Value columns were not found in this Stock Summary.
reports.errBsHeader: No Liabilities / Assets or Particulars columns were found in this Balance Sheet.
reports.errBsColumns: No amount columns were found in this Balance Sheet.
reports.errBsSections: This vertical Balance Sheet has no “Liabilities” and “Assets” sections.
reports.errNoRows: No rows were found in this file.
reports.errExcel: This sheet could not be read. Export it from TallyPrime as Excel (.xlsx) and try again.
reports.errXml: This is not a Tally XML export.

check.title: {{file}} · {{count}} lines read
check.companyMismatch: The file is from “{{file}}”, but you chose “{{chosen}}”. Check that this is the right company before loading.
check.name: Name
check.ledgerTotals: Ledgers add up to debit {{dr}} and credit {{cr}}
check.tallyTotals: Grand total in the file: debit {{dr}} and credit {{cr}}
check.notBalanced: Debit and credit differ by {{diff}}. It can be staged, but it cannot be applied until this is fixed.
check.groupOnly: This Trial Balance lists groups only. Export the expanded, ledger-wise Trial Balance from TallyPrime (Alt+F5 on the Trial Balance screen) and load that file.
check.negative: {{count}} lines have zero or negative quantity. They are not posted; each goes to the Bug fixer.

warn.identical_lines: {{count}} lines are exact repeats of an earlier line. Each is kept as its own voucher.
warn.no_amount: {{count}} lines have no amount (for example stock journals). They are kept with amount 0.
warn.no_type: {{count}} lines have no voucher type and are skipped.
warn.grand_total_differs: The ledger lines do not add up to the file’s Grand Total ({{detail}}). Some rows may have been mistaken for groups; check the preview.
warn.opening_difference: The file shows “Diff. in opening balances” ({{detail}}). Tally’s own opening balances are not balanced.
warn.side_total_differs: A side’s lines do not add up to its Total ({{detail}}).

check.confirmEffect: Stores {{count}} Day Book lines ({{from}} to {{to}}) as reference history in {{company}}. Nothing is posted to the books. Loading the same file again is skipped.

panel.title: {{kind}} · as of {{asOf}}
panel.applyTbHelp: Sets each ledger’s opening balance from this report. Nothing is posted; bill-wise detail stays as loaded. Only Admin can do this, only when debit equals credit and every ledger’s Tally group is mapped. The CA should sign the numbers first.
panel.applyTbConfirmTitle: Set opening balances from this Trial Balance?
panel.applyTbConfirmEffect: Sets the opening balance of {{count}} ledgers of {{company}} as of {{asOf}} (missing ledgers are created under their mapped group). Nothing is posted. A report is applied once.
panel.applyStockHelp: Posts each item’s quantity at Tally’s rate into the store you choose, once. Zero or negative lines are not posted (Bug fixer). Items not in the product list must be mapped or created first.
panel.applyStockConfirmTitle: Post opening stock from this Stock Summary?
panel.applyStockConfirmEffect: Adds {{count}} items to the store as opening stock dated {{asOf}} at the Tally rates. It cannot be applied twice and each line is part of the stock ledger for good.
panel.balanceHelp: A Balance Sheet is kept for reconciliation only. It never posts anything.
panel.refusedTotal: Refused: debit {{dr}} and credit {{cr}} differ by {{diff}}.
panel.refusedUnmapped: Refused: these Tally groups are not mapped yet: {{groups}}.
panel.unmatchedTitle: Items not in the product list
panel.unmatchedHelp: Map each to an existing product, or create the product on the Products screen (you choose its HSN and unit), then apply again.

compare.title: Compared with the ERP
compare.help: Difference = ERP − Tally (debit positive for the Trial Balance). Opening balances and posted entries up to the report date are compared.
